_about: Traditional racing silks for the 3D jockey, described the way registered colours are: body, sleeves and cap, each a colour plus an optional pattern in a second colour. tools/silks/make_silks.py paints each set into the jacket's texture layout. The menu artwork in assets/silks stays as it is. Colours are names from the palette below; patterns are listed in tools/README.md.
